summary: Added Arcade size filter chips (T1 1-2, T2 3-9, T3 10-19, T4 20-49, T5 50+, TU unknown) matching marker tiers. Default all tiers on (map unchanged). isVisible and applyFilters AND selectedSizeTiers; markers rebuild on selectedSizeTiers. Session-only state (not localStorage). No hash segment.
how_to_verify: Open index.html locally or serve the site
Filters drawer: Arcade size section after Cab variants with 6 chips and all/none
Default: all chips on, marker count unchanged from before
Click all: map restores full plottable set under other filters
Toggle off U: unknown-count stores disappear; T1-T5 remain
Toggle only 50+: only mega arcades remain
Nearby list respects size filter via isVisible
Reload: size selection resets to all (not persisted)
risks: applyFilters still duplicates isVisible logic (pre-existing); size check added in both places so they can drift if one is updated later
Chip counts are static plottable-by-tier totals and do not shrink under game/source/cab filters (unlike game chips)
No URL hash for size= so share links cannot encode size filter
Most plottable stores are TU; filtering only counted tiers leaves a small subset
